Make sure you have put on a pair of CNC safety goggles before you set up the CNC carver and wear them throughout the carving process.
Secure the material to the CNC Carving Platform with the provided clamp sets.
Tilt the collet into the nut, insert the Flat End Mill into the collet until the shank bottoms against the collet, and then twist the nut onto the CNC carver with the provided wrenches.

In auto mode, the height of the Laser Module will be automatically calculated by the machine.
The machine measures the material thickness and does automatic focusing.
In manual mode, the height of the Laser Module will be determined by observing and adjusting the laser spot.
You need to manually lower the Toolhead. Then the machine does automatic focusing.

Conditions that might cause thickness measurement failure: 
1. The material thickness is over 50 mm 
2. The material texture is transparent, or the material surface is glossy or specular 
3. The material color is red or black
Tap Start, and manually lower the Toolhead against the material surface. Then tap Next, the machine will do automatic focusing.

Adjust the Laser Module\'s Z offset until the laser beam is focused into the smallest spot possible. Then, jog the Laser Module to work origin.

Camera Calibration ensures the camera functions properly.

Fix a piece of blank white paper (not less than 150 × 150 mm) to the center of the Laser Engraving/Cutting Platform using the provided silicone plugs. The machine will cut a square on the paper to calibrate the camera parameters.

Fix a piece of blank A4 paper on the center of the platform. The machine will cut a square on the paper to calibrate the camera. Before tapping Start, make sure you have worn the Laser Safety Goggles.
Do not move the paper during the process.
When toggled on, the machine will turn on the camera light automatically during Laser Calibration or Camera Calibration.
When enabled, the machine will turn on the camera light automatically during Camera Calibration.

Before proceeding to carve, you can use the Origin Assistant to set work origin, which will be stored in the system. So in future carving sessions, as long as the dimensions of the material remain unchanged, you can select your files and start right away.
Secure the material to the Chuck and leave no gap between their contact surfaces. \n \nDo not install the Tailstock yet.
Select from the four bits, or choose a custom bit. Then attach it to the collet.
Toolhead will move to near the material. Follow the instructions to move the bit to the positions shown on the screen. Then tap Set to confirm each coordinate.
Leaving this page will cause you to lose unsaved work origin data. Are you sure you want to leave?
You have successfully completed the initial setup for rotary carving. Now you can choose a file to start making.

Bit Assistant is similar to a Tool Presetter. It guides you to manipulate the bits to touch the same spot of your choice, and the system will work out the Z offset. Once you\'ve changed the bit, you can use previously set work origin and start carving right away. \n \nNote: Upon finishing rough machining, keep the bit where it is, until the system prompts you to change it.
Now change the CNC bit to a new one.\n \n Manipulate the new CNC bit to slightly touch the same chosen spot by adjusting the Z Offset. Tap Set.
Congratulations! You have completed the work origin setup for finish machining. Select your file on the Touchscreen, and you are ready to go.
